sections.heading: The buying case: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The Skyline 2000GT-R is a good fit for the Hakosuka enthusiast who wants a finished scale road car without a kit’s electronics and body-painting decisions. Its silver tuned shell, widened stance and vintage wheels give the complete model a clear identity, while the FZ02 underneath is a conventional brushed 4WD road platform. The reservation is that this body appeal should not be used to justify rough-ground expectations or an expensive immediate power conversion.

Our exact subject is 34425T1C, verified by Amazon under that current suffix. The manufacturer's C page establishes the reviewed complete Readyset; older independent coverage identifies 34425T1. We treat that earlier coverage as context for the same Skyline subject and broad package, not proof that every component revision in the C box is identical. It is not a replacement body, a Mini-Z or a body-less Fazer chassis.

I would shortlist the silver Skyline for a buyer who wants open-pavement scale driving and likes this specific vintage Nissan shape. It is less compelling when the main requirements are serious racing, dedicated RWD drifting or grass running. The editorial rating assesses the documented complete purchase for that buyer. We have no hands-on mileage, timed laps, impact test or reliability sample, and the presence of a manufacturer action video is not substituted for those missing measurements.

sections.heading: The complete package: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The Readyset supplies an assembled FZ02 chassis, painted and decorated Skyline body, G14L brushed motor, fitted speed control, KS202W servo and Syncro KT-231P+ transmitter. Its documented full bearings and oil shocks are already part of the running package. This is the value of an assembled complete car: the radio, steering and body are coordinated before the buyer begins the first-session preparation.

The remaining essentials are four AA transmitter cells, a suitable drive battery and compatible charger. The product page recommends SPEED HOUSE 7.2 V NiMH packs and listed charging options. Match the actual connector and physical battery space before reusing a pack, and read the controller instructions if considering another chemistry. The fact that two cars are both called Fazer does not establish identical battery settings or electronics revisions.

Light buckets can accept separately sold LED units, but working lights are an optional purchase. Begin with wheel attachment, suspension freedom and control checks, then learn the body's removal procedure. Keep the shell on a clean surface while accessing the battery. I would settle the power route first and avoid mixing a lighting installation, motor swap and first radio setup into one evening. The coordinated stock package is more useful when you preserve its baseline long enough to understand it.

sections.heading: Drivetrain and power: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The Skyline uses shaft-driven full-time 4WD and gear differentials front and rear. The G14L is brushed, and Kyosho publishes a 6.54:1 standard ratio for the platform. Full ball bearings reduce the need to decide on a bearing purchase during initial completion. Those are real equipment facts; they should not be extended into a quantified efficiency, grip or top-speed claim without an actual test.

The differentials allow each axle’s wheels to turn at different speeds in corners, while the shaft links front and rear drive. This is a conventional touring arrangement rather than a rear-drive drift system. A buyer attracted to the tuned overfenders may reasonably imagine a drift car, but the standard VTC-tire Readyset is sold with a road-driving brief. Decide which discipline you want before treating the body’s visual attitude as a mechanical specification.

The motor mount provides documented positions for different pinions. That can make later gearing work easier to understand, but it does not make every taller ratio appropriate to the supplied motor or your intended pack. Establish the installed setup, check free wheel rotation and listen for an unexpected mechanical problem during gentle running. More power cannot cure an incorrectly seated shaft or debris around a joint. I would keep the supplied brushed system for the first ownership stage because this review’s value case is the complete stock Skyline, not a shell acquired as the beginning of a costly electronics rebuild.

sections.heading: Radio and setup: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The supplied transmitter gives a pistol-grip driving interface with documented trim and steering adjustment. Set neutral positions and verify steering direction before running. The basic setup task is shorter than installing your own radio in a kit, but still important. Check the actual speed controller's calibration and startup instructions rather than assuming a familiar-looking Kyosho radio guarantees identical settings across every regional car.

Steering endpoints should match the mechanical range. With the body fitted, turn slowly and confirm that the servo is not forcing a stop or the tires rubbing the shell. If the car does not track straight, inspect trim, linkage and tires before adding repeated electronic correction. Keep the battery lead and electronics cables clear of the center drive and suspension, particularly after body removal or a pack change.

Tim Mohr’s Big Squid RC coverage identifies the earlier 34425T1 and embeds Kyosho’s Skyline action video. That is attributable release context, with the moving footage belonging to the manufacturer. It does not establish a controlled independent test of our exact C-suffix offer. We also do not retain the old $249 launch reference as current pricing. The source helps explain the Skyline’s appearance and road-car presentation while the manufacturer documents establish today's reviewed identity and the API establishes the exact listed complete car.

sections.heading: Steering and suspension: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: Oil-filled shocks and independent suspension form a useful stock equipment package for a casual road driver. The KS202W steering servo is fitted, so there is no need to choose a servo merely to get a complete car running. The stock geometry and wheel offsets still need respect if you change wheels later. A different rim can look suitable while moving the tire into the body at full steering or suspension travel.

The manufacturer’s wheelbase for the standard FZ02 Skyline is 260 mm. The stock car's stance is coordinated with its body rather than left for the buyer to establish from a generic chassis kit. Check the exact model instructions before using longer-platform parts or another shell. The broader Fazer family supports several body lengths; that flexibility does not make all mounting arrangements interchangeable without work.

For adjustment, preserve the stock baseline and alter one thing on a familiar surface. If changing shock settings, compare left and right movement and avoid confusing a sticking pivot with damping. The decorative brake discs and calipers are scale details, not separate functional brakes that need a tuning procedure. Our rating credits the understandable supplied suspension and documented platform, without claiming a measured steering improvement over another Fazer. For this buyer, the practical value is learning a complete standard car before deciding whether there is a specific adjustment worth making.

sections.heading: Where to drive: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The silver Skyline is a low road model. I would use clean pavement or a suitable smooth RC track area, with room to turn and brake away from hard edges. The VTC tires and scale body are part of that brief. A dusty parking lot may be discussed in the manufacturer’s sealed-transmission claims, but dust is not the same thing as large loose stones, deep grass or off-road obstacles.

Begin with gentle straight runs and broad turns to verify the controls and body clearance. Keep a predictable route and pay attention to debris that can abruptly interrupt a line. This is particularly helpful for someone returning to RC after years away, since the finished appearance can make the model feel more familiar than the actual radio and battery setup. A calm first session confirms your own car rather than attempting to reproduce a quick action-video sequence.

After running, remove loose dirt around the wheels, shocks and shafts and check that nothing has wrapped around the driveline. Inspect the body mounting and mirrors before putting the car away. The servo’s waterproof designation does not establish unlimited wet use for every connector and moving component. Follow the complete maintenance guidance and actual electronics limits. We have not tested water exposure or long-term wear. The recommendation is for dry scale pavement driving, where the exact body and stock running equipment provide the ownership experience the buyer selected.

sections.heading: Body and service: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The tuned KPGC10 body is the Skyline’s strongest hook. Silver paint, overfenders and Watanabe-style wheels give the ready-made model a distinct seventies-Japanese-road identity. The body is finished, so the purchase avoids the trimming, masking and decal labor of a clear-shell kit. That is legitimate value for the buyer who would rather spend the first evening preparing a battery than creating the appearance from scratch.

The current manufacturer listing and exact API SKU identify the C-suffix Readyset. Older sources use the shorter T1 identity; the review keeps that history visible rather than quietly combining all details. The official gallery’s body-off chassis and underside views show the running platform beneath the appearance. They are manufacturer photography and explain service access, not evidence that we have disassembled or driven a physical Skyline.

Use the supplied mounting procedure, support the chassis when carrying it and keep the shell clear of loose screws during maintenance. Mirrors and trim are exposed scale features, so choose a practice area that does not routinely scrape them against walls. Optional lights should be priced and fitted separately if they appeal. I would preserve the standard silver body as the first ownership stage and use its actual tire clearances when evaluating any wheel change. Buying a scale Readyset makes the finished presentation important enough to protect during ordinary service.

paragraphs: The exact KYO34425T1C Tower Hobbies listing retains $249.99 while marking the car discontinued and not orderable there. Do not read either the archived price or cached manufacturer material as proof of ongoing factory availability. Keep the body, suffix and complete power-equipment basket visible when comparing this silver Skyline with a currently listed alternative.

The first-session basket consists of the complete Readyset, four AA transmitter cells, suitable drive battery and matching charger. Kyosho recommends 7.2 V NiMH options on the reviewed page. The power items still need physical fit and connector confirmation, and any different chemistry needs the actual controller instructions. Current US prices for all chosen accessories are not established together here, so the article does not manufacture a subtotal from a nominal allowance.

Optional lights, spare bodies and brushless conversions should remain separate purchases. Existing compatible equipment can simplify the total, but a battery that needs another connector or cannot fit the holder is not useful reuse. I would compare the standard Skyline with other complete vintage road cars, including the same power-equipment costs in each basket. If the main plan is to replace motor, controller, radio and wheels, write that total down before buying. The reviewed package earns value from its coordinated stock hardware and finished body, which an immediate conversion partly discards.

sections.heading: Real alternatives: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The Kyosho Toyota Celica GT 34429T1 is a complete-car alternative for a buyer who likes vintage Japanese road subjects but is not fixed on the Nissan. Its turquoise body and tuned trim provide a different appearance on a documented brushed road package. The choice can reasonably turn on the body you want to own; there is no need to fabricate a measured handling ranking to justify that preference.

The Fazer Mk2 El Camino SS396 Cortez Silver 34419T2 changes the subject and moves to the long FZ02L format. Consider it when the Chevrolet pickup silhouette is more attractive than the Hakosuka. Check its discontinued manufacturer status and remaining retailer offer. A long wheelbase and finished body are purchase facts, not proof of superior stability or a reason to apply the Skyline’s dimensions to it.

For dedicated RWD drifting, the Fazer D2 Toyota86 Readyset is a category change worth making before shopping. It has drift-specific rear drive, plastic drift tires and receiver/gyro equipment rather than relying on the attitude of a touring body. I would take the Skyline for scale pavement driving, the Celica for its Toyota subject and the D2 when drifting is the actual discipline. A bare chassis with a low headline price is not used as a complete-car alternative because the body and electronics completion would hide much of the purchase being compared.

sections.heading: Buying verdict: Fazer Mk2 Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R KPGC10 Silver
paragraphs: The silver Skyline’s case is straightforward: a finished Hakosuka subject with coordinated radio, brushed power, 4WD, bearings and oil shocks. It is attractive for the vintage Nissan buyer who wants to begin with road driving rather than kit completion. Its reservations are separate battery equipment, a limited smooth-ground role and the risk of buying it mainly to replace its stock system before use.

Our five categories assess Readyset completeness, subject presentation, documented running gear, service planning and whole-purchase value for the scale pavement buyer. No measured cornering, speed, crash survival or reliability score is assigned. The earlier T1 video coverage is labeled as context and its manufacturer footage remains distinct from independent testing. Current C-suffix documentation and API identity establish the exact reviewed offer rather than an assumed family-wide equivalence.

I would choose this Skyline when the silver body is the object you want and the standard brushed road package suits your driving area. Arrange the pack and charger, establish the neutral controls and enjoy a few stock sessions before considering options. I would skip it for grass, a dedicated RWD drift track or a conversion plan that makes most included equipment redundant. On the intended terms, it is a clear complete-car purchase whose appearance and ownership convenience support each other, provided the buyer respects the low road chassis beneath the memorable shell.
